activity_summary: At St Helen's Master Thwaite said he would be brief, and reached fourteenthly. The sand-glass was turned twice. You caught yourself out of the pew and came back. Sir John Spencer sat three rows ahead and did not turn. You are not coughing.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Caught himself out of the sermon and returned.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Promised brevity, reached fourteenthly, and had the glass turned twice.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Kept him in the pew and named the amen.

entities.name: Sir John Spencer
entities.context: Sat three rows ahead. He did not turn and he did not speak.

facets.activity: Sat Master Thwaite's sermon and came back into the pew

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Sir John is three rows ahead;
